words.def_en: to give up or leave behind completely
words.example: Faced with repeated crop failures, the settlers abandoned the valley within a decade.
words.example_zh: 由于庄稼连年歉收，定居者在十年内就放弃了这片河谷。

words.def_en: present in very large quantities
words.example: Fossils are abundant in the limestone of this region, so specimens are easy to collect.
words.example_zh: 该地区的石灰岩中化石十分丰富，因此标本很容易采集。

words.def_en: to make something happen faster
words.example: Warmer temperatures accelerate the chemical weathering of exposed rock.
words.example_zh: 较高的气温会加速裸露岩石的化学风化。

words.def_en: to provide enough room for; to adjust to fit needs
words.example: The lecture hall was rebuilt to accommodate twice as many students.
words.example_zh: 报告厅经过重建，可以容纳两倍的学生。

words.def_en: to increase gradually in amount over time
words.example: Sediment accumulates on the lake bed at a rate of about one millimeter a year.
words.example_zh: 沉积物在湖底以每年约一毫米的速度堆积。

words.def_en: correct in every detail
words.example: Only an accurate measurement of the star's brightness can settle the dispute.
words.example_zh: 只有对该恒星亮度的精确测量才能解决这一争论。

words.def_en: to get or come to possess something
words.example: Infants acquire the sound system of their native language before their first birthday.
words.example_zh: 婴儿在一岁之前就掌握了母语的语音系统。

words.def_en: to change in order to suit new conditions
words.example: Desert plants have adapted to drought by storing water in thick stems.
words.example_zh: 沙漠植物通过在粗壮的茎中储水来适应干旱。

words.def_en: enough for a particular purpose
words.example: The soil provides adequate nitrogen for grasses but not for cultivated grain.
words.example_zh: 这种土壤为草类提供了足够的氮，但不足以支持栽培谷物。

words.def_en: next to or very near something
words.example: The workshops stood adjacent to the temple, so artisans could deliver goods quickly.
words.example_zh: 作坊紧邻神庙，因此工匠可以迅速交付货物。

words.def_en: to publicly support or argue for
words.example: Several economists advocate taxing emissions rather than capping them.
words.example_zh: 一些经济学家主张对排放征税，而不是设定上限。

words.def_en: concerned with beauty or artistic effect
words.example: The changes were aesthetic rather than structural, since the bridge was already sound.
words.example_zh: 这些改动属于审美层面而非结构层面，因为桥梁本身已经很牢固。

words.def_en: to make a problem or pain less severe
words.example: Irrigation canals alleviated the effects of the drought but did not end it.
words.example_zh: 灌溉渠缓解了旱情的影响，但并未彻底解决问题。

words.def_en: to change something partly
words.example: Dams alter the temperature of the river far downstream of the wall.
words.example_zh: 水坝会改变大坝下游很远处河水的温度。

words.def_en: having more than one possible meaning; unclear
words.example: The inscription is ambiguous, and scholars read it as either a date or a name.
words.example_zh: 这段铭文含义模糊，学者们把它读作日期或人名皆有。

words.def_en: a comparison that shows how two things are alike
words.example: The professor drew an analogy between the brain and a telephone switchboard.
words.example_zh: 教授把大脑与电话交换台作了类比。

words.def_en: something that differs from what is normal or expected
words.example: The unusually warm winter was treated as an anomaly rather than a trend.
words.example_zh: 那个异常温暖的冬天被视为反常现象，而不是趋势。

words.def_en: to expect something and prepare for it
words.example: Merchants anticipated the shortage and stored grain the previous autumn.
words.example_zh: 商人预料到了这次短缺，在前一年秋天就储存了粮食。

words.def_en: easily seen or understood; clear
words.example: The damage to the outer wall was apparent even from a distance.
words.example_zh: 外墙的损坏即使从远处也清晰可见。

words.def_en: based on personal choice rather than reason or rule
words.example: The boundary was arbitrary, since it followed no river, ridge, or ethnic division.
words.example_zh: 这条边界是任意划定的，因为它既不沿河流、山脊，也不依族群分布。

words.def_en: to express an idea clearly in words
words.example: The report articulates a standard that earlier committees had only implied.
words.example_zh: 这份报告清晰地阐明了此前各委员会只是含蓄提及的标准。

words.def_en: to judge the value, quality, or amount of
words.example: Ecologists assess the health of a reef by counting fish species.
words.example_zh: 生态学家通过统计鱼类物种数量来评估珊瑚礁的健康状况。

words.def_en: to accept something as true without proof
words.example: The model assumes that the population grows at a constant rate.
words.example_zh: 该模型假定人口以恒定速率增长。

words.def_en: to reach or achieve something after effort
words.example: Some redwoods attain a height of more than one hundred meters.
words.example_zh: 有些红杉能长到一百多米高。

words.def_en: to say that something is caused by a particular thing
words.example: Historians attribute the city's decline to the silting of its harbor.
words.example_zh: 历史学家把这座城市的衰落归因于港口的淤塞。

words.def_en: to add to something in order to make it greater
words.example: Farmers augmented their income by weaving cloth during the winter months.
words.example_zh: 农民在冬季通过织布来增加收入。

words.def_en: able to govern or act independently
words.example: Each colony remained autonomous, collecting its own taxes and writing its own laws.
words.example_zh: 每个殖民地都保持自治，自行征税并制定自己的法律。

words.def_en: able to be obtained or used
words.example: Iron was widely available in the region, so bronze tools quickly disappeared.
words.example_zh: 该地区铁矿广泛可得，因此青铜工具很快消失了。

words.def_en: gentle and not harmful
words.example: The climate of the valley was benign enough to permit two harvests a year.
words.example_zh: 这个河谷的气候相当温和，足以一年两熟。

words.def_en: logically connected and easy to follow
words.example: The scattered notes were finally organized into a coherent argument.
words.example_zh: 这些零散的笔记最终被整理成一个条理清晰的论证。

words.def_en: to happen at the same time; to be in agreement
words.example: The eruption coincided with a sharp drop in global temperatures.
words.example_zh: 这次火山喷发与全球气温的骤降同时发生。

words.def_en: to fall down suddenly; to fail completely
words.example: The trade network collapsed once the coastal cities lost their fleets.
words.example_zh: 沿海城市失去船队后，这个贸易网络随即崩溃。

words.def_en: to make up for a loss or weakness
words.example: Nocturnal animals compensate for poor color vision with acute hearing.
words.example_zh: 夜行动物以敏锐的听觉弥补色觉的不足。

words.def_en: one of the parts that make up a whole
words.example: Nitrogen is the largest component of the atmosphere by volume.
words.example_zh: 按体积计算，氮是大气中含量最大的成分。

words.def_en: including everything relevant; complete
words.example: The survey was comprehensive, covering every village in the province.
words.example_zh: 这项调查十分全面，覆盖了该省的每一个村庄。

words.def_en: to consist of; to be made up of
words.example: The archipelago comprises more than two hundred small volcanic islands.
words.example_zh: 这个群岛由两百多个火山小岛组成。

words.def_en: to decide something after considering evidence
words.example: The team concluded that the pottery had been imported rather than made locally.
words.example_zh: 研究团队断定这些陶器是进口的，而非本地制造。

words.def_en: to keep within limits or in an enclosed space
words.example: The species is confined to a single valley in the northern highlands.
words.example_zh: 该物种仅局限于北部高地的一个山谷。

words.def_en: to behave according to accepted rules or patterns
words.example: The new data do not conform to the predictions of the older model.
words.example_zh: 新数据与旧模型的预测并不相符。

words.def_en: a result of an earlier action or event
words.example: One consequence of clearing the forest was the loss of topsoil.
words.example_zh: 砍伐森林的一个后果是表层土壤的流失。

words.def_en: to protect something from loss or waste
words.example: Hibernating mammals conserve energy by lowering their body temperature.
words.example_zh: 冬眠的哺乳动物通过降低体温来节省能量。

words.def_en: large in size, amount, or importance
words.example: The library holds a considerable collection of medieval maps.
words.example_zh: 该图书馆藏有相当数量的中世纪地图。

words.def_en: to form or make up something
words.example: Women constituted nearly half of the factory workforce by 1890.
words.example_zh: 到1890年，女性已占工厂劳动力的近一半。

words.def_en: belonging to the same period of time; modern
words.example: Contemporary accounts of the flood survive in three separate chronicles.
words.example_zh: 关于这场洪水的同时代记载保存在三部不同的编年史中。

words.def_en: depending on something else that may or may not happen
words.def_zh: 视情况而定的；取决于…的
words.example: Funding for the excavation was contingent on the discovery of intact tombs.
words.example_zh: 发掘工作的资金取决于是否能发现完整的墓葬。

words.def_en: a clear difference between two things compared
words.example: The contrast between the two soils explains the difference in crop yields.
words.example_zh: 两种土壤之间的差异解释了作物产量的不同。

words.def_en: to give a share toward a result
words.example: Overgrazing contributed to the spread of the dunes across the plain.
words.example_zh: 过度放牧促成了沙丘在平原上的扩展。

words.def_en: causing strong public disagreement
words.example: The dating of the site remains controversial among archaeologists.
words.example_zh: 该遗址的年代测定在考古学家中仍有争议。

words.def_en: to come together at one point
words.example: Three trade routes converged at the oasis, making it unusually wealthy.
words.example_zh: 三条商路在这片绿洲汇合，使其格外富庶。

words.def_en: to have a mutual relationship or connection
words.example: Tree ring width correlates closely with rainfall in that century.
words.example_zh: 在那个世纪，年轮宽度与降雨量密切相关。

words.def_en: a standard used for judging or deciding
words.example: Size alone is a poor criterion for classifying these organisms.
words.example_zh: 仅凭大小是划分这些生物的糟糕标准。

words.def_en: extremely important; decisive
words.example: Access to fresh water was crucial to the survival of the early settlement.
words.example_zh: 获取淡水对早期定居点的存续至关重要。

words.def_en: to prepare and use land for crops; to develop carefully
words.example: Farmers cultivated terraces on slopes too steep for ordinary fields.
words.example_zh: 农民在过陡而无法开辟普通农田的坡地上修筑梯田耕种。

words.def_en: to decrease in number, quality, or strength
words.example: Bird populations declined sharply after the wetlands were drained.
words.example_zh: 湿地排干之后，鸟类种群数量急剧下降。

words.def_en: to state the exact meaning or limits of
words.example: The author defines culture broadly enough to include technology.
words.example_zh: 作者对文化的界定十分宽泛，甚至把技术也包括在内。

words.def_en: done on purpose after careful thought
words.example: The asymmetry of the facade was deliberate, not the result of poor planning.
words.example_zh: 立面的不对称是有意为之，而非规划不当的结果。

words.def_en: to describe or mark the boundaries of something precisely
words.example: The report delineates three stages in the collapse of the fishery.
words.example_zh: 该报告清晰描述了渔业崩溃的三个阶段。

words.def_en: to show clearly by evidence or example
words.example: The experiment demonstrates that seedlings grow faster in diffuse light.
words.example_zh: 实验表明幼苗在散射光下生长得更快。

words.def_en: to obtain something from a particular source
words.example: The islanders derive most of their protein from shellfish.
words.example_zh: 岛民的蛋白质大多来自贝类。

words.def_en: to discover or notice something not easily seen
words.example: Instruments detected a faint tremor hours before the eruption.
words.example_zh: 仪器在喷发前数小时探测到轻微震动。

words.def_en: to become progressively worse
words.example: The manuscripts deteriorated rapidly once the humidity control failed.
words.example_zh: 湿度控制失效后，这些手稿迅速损坏。

words.def_en: to become or make smaller or less
words.example: The influence of the guilds diminished as factories multiplied.
words.example_zh: 随着工厂增多，行会的影响力逐渐减弱。

words.def_en: to perceive or recognize something with difficulty
words.example: It is hard to discern a pattern in such an incomplete record.
words.example_zh: 在如此不完整的记录中很难辨认出规律。

words.def_en: separate and distinct from others
words.example: The deposits fall into four discrete layers, each with its own fossils.
words.example_zh: 这些沉积物分为四个彼此分开的层，各有其化石。

words.def_en: essentially different and unrelated in kind
words.example: The theory draws on disparate fields, from linguistics to geology.
words.example_zh: 该理论借鉴了从语言学到地质学等迥异的领域。

words.def_en: to force something or someone out of its usual place
words.example: The introduced grass displaced native species within a single decade.
words.example_zh: 这种引入的草在十年内就取代了本地物种。

words.def_en: clearly different or separate; easy to notice
words.example: The two dialects have distinct vowel systems despite a shared vocabulary.
words.example_zh: 尽管词汇相通，这两种方言的元音系统截然不同。

words.def_en: to spread or share out over an area or group
words.example: The seeds are distributed by wind across several kilometers.
words.example_zh: 这些种子随风散布到数公里之外。

words.def_en: varied; of many different kinds
words.example: The reef supports a diverse community of fish and invertebrates.
words.example_zh: 这片珊瑚礁养育着种类繁多的鱼类和无脊椎动物。

words.def_en: to have controlling power or the largest presence
words.example: Conifers dominate the forest above nine hundred meters.
words.example_zh: 在九百米以上，针叶树在森林中占主导地位。

words.def_en: complicated and carefully worked out in detail
words.example: The tombs contained elaborate carvings that took years to complete.
words.example_zh: 这些墓中有耗时数年才完成的精美雕刻。

words.def_en: to draw out a response or reaction
words.example: The recorded call elicited an immediate alarm response from the flock.
words.example_zh: 录音的叫声立刻引起了鸟群的警戒反应。

words.def_en: to remove or get rid of completely
words.example: Drainage eliminated the mosquito breeding grounds near the port.
words.example_zh: 排水工程清除了港口附近的蚊虫滋生地。

words.def_en: difficult to find, catch, or describe
words.def_zh: 难以捉摸的；难以找到的
words.example: The cause of the extinction remains elusive despite decades of study.
words.example_zh: 尽管研究了数十年，这次灭绝的原因仍然难以确定。

words.def_en: to come into view or become known
words.example: A clear seasonal pattern emerged once the data were plotted by month.
words.example_zh: 按月份绘图后，明显的季节性规律就显现出来了。

words.def_en: to give special importance or attention to
words.example: The lecture emphasizes trade rather than warfare as the engine of change.
words.example_zh: 这堂课强调贸易而非战争是变革的动力。

words.def_en: based on observation or experiment rather than theory
words.example: Empirical support for the model came from three field seasons of data.
words.example_zh: 该模型的实证支持来自三个野外季的数据。

words.def_en: to make it possible for something to happen
words.example: The stirrup enabled riders to fight effectively with heavy weapons.
words.example_zh: 马镫使骑手能够有效使用重型武器作战。

words.def_en: to continue to exist; to bear hardship
words.example: The pigments endured for centuries because the cave stayed dry.
words.example_zh: 由于洞穴保持干燥，这些颜料留存了数百年。

words.def_en: to improve the quality or value of
words.example: Adding lime enhanced the fertility of the acidic soil.
words.example_zh: 施加石灰提高了这种酸性土壤的肥力。

words.def_en: to make certain that something happens
words.example: Thick walls ensured that the granary stayed cool through the summer.
words.example_zh: 厚墙确保粮仓整个夏天都保持凉爽。

words.def_en: to involve something as a necessary part or result
words.example: Domesticating the plant entailed a long period of selective breeding.
words.example_zh: 驯化这种植物必然要经过长期的选择育种。

words.def_en: equal in value, amount, or meaning
words.example: One barrel of the oil yields energy equivalent to a ton of coal.
words.example_zh: 一桶这种石油产生的能量相当于一吨煤。

words.def_en: to wear away gradually by wind or water
words.example: Winter storms eroded nearly a meter of the cliff face each year.
words.example_zh: 冬季风暴每年侵蚀掉将近一米的崖面。

words.def_en: to set up or found; to prove firmly
words.example: The society established a laboratory for testing local water supplies.
words.example_zh: 该学会建立了一间实验室来检测当地的供水。

words.def_en: to judge an amount or value approximately
words.example: Researchers estimate the herd at roughly four thousand animals.
words.example_zh: 研究人员估计这个畜群约有四千头。

words.def_en: facts that support a conclusion
words.example: There is little evidence that the temple was ever finished.
words.example_zh: 几乎没有证据表明这座神庙曾经建成。

words.def_en: to develop gradually into a different form
words.example: The writing system evolved from a set of accounting marks.
words.example_zh: 这套文字系统由一组记账符号逐渐演变而来。

words.def_en: to be greater than a limit or expected amount
words.example: Summer rainfall exceeded the annual average in a single week.
words.example_zh: 一周之内的夏季降雨量就超过了全年平均值。

words.def_en: to keep out or leave out
words.example: The census excluded households outside the city walls.
words.example_zh: 这次人口普查未把城墙以外的住户计算在内。

words.def_en: to apply force, influence, or effort
words.example: The moon exerts a stronger pull on the near side of the earth.
words.example_zh: 月球对地球近侧施加的引力更强。

words.def_en: to show or display a quality or object
words.example: The alloy exhibits unusual strength at very low temperatures.
words.example_zh: 这种合金在极低温下表现出异常的强度。

words.def_en: to become larger in size or scope
words.example: The empire expanded rapidly along the river valleys.
words.example_zh: 帝国沿着河谷迅速扩张。

words.def_en: stated clearly and directly, leaving no doubt
words.example: The treaty is explicit about fishing rights but silent on mineral claims.
words.example_zh: 该条约对捕鱼权规定明确，但对矿产权只字未提。

words.def_en: to make full use of a resource, often unfairly
words.example: Whalers exploited the northern grounds until the stocks collapsed.
words.example_zh: 捕鲸者不断开采北部渔场，直到种群崩溃。

words.def_en: to make a process easier
words.example: The new canal facilitated the movement of grain to the coast.
words.example_zh: 新运河使粮食运往沿海更加便利。

words.def_en: one of the things that influences a result
words.example: Soil depth is the decisive factor in where the trees can grow.
words.example_zh: 土层深度是决定树木能否生长的关键因素。

words.def_en: a noticeable part or characteristic
words.example: A distinctive feature of the style is the use of unbroken curves.
words.example_zh: 这种风格的一个显著特征是使用连续不断的曲线。

words.def_en: to rise and fall irregularly
words.example: Lake levels fluctuated widely during the last two thousand years.
words.example_zh: 在过去两千年里，湖面高度大幅波动。

words.def_en: to encourage the growth or development of
words.example: Cheap printing fostered a new market for scientific journals.
words.example_zh: 廉价印刷催生了科学期刊的新市场。

words.def_en: forming a necessary base; most basic
words.example: Symmetry is a fundamental property of the crystal, not an accident of growth.
words.example_zh: 对称性是这种晶体的基本性质，而非生长中的偶然。

words.def_en: to produce or create something
words.example: Decaying vegetation generates enough heat to keep the nest warm.
words.example_zh: 腐烂的植物产生的热量足以使巢保持温暖。

words.def_en: a system in which things are ranked one above another
words.example: The excavation revealed a clear hierarchy of house sizes.
words.example_zh: 发掘揭示出房屋规模上明显的等级差别。

words.def_en: a proposed explanation to be tested
words.example: The hypothesis predicts that the isotopes will differ between the two sites.
words.example_zh: 该假说预测两处遗址的同位素会有差别。

words.def_en: to recognize or establish what something is
words.example: Chemists identified the residue as beeswax rather than resin.
words.example_zh: 化学家确认这种残留物是蜂蜡而非树脂。

words.def_en: to slow down or block the progress of
words.example: Dense undergrowth impeded the survey team for weeks.
words.example_zh: 茂密的灌木丛使勘测队受阻数周。

words.def_en: to suggest something without stating it directly
words.example: The wear on the tools implies that they were used for cutting bone.
words.example_zh: 工具上的磨损暗示它们曾被用来切割骨头。

words.def_en: to force something on someone; to establish by authority
words.example: The government imposed a tax on imported dyes.
words.example_zh: 政府对进口染料征税。

words.def_en: something that encourages a person to act
words.example: Land grants gave settlers an incentive to move west.
words.example_zh: 土地授予给了定居者向西迁移的动力。

words.def_en: to include something as part of a whole
words.example: Later builders incorporated the older wall into the new foundation.
words.example_zh: 后来的建造者把旧墙纳入了新的地基。

words.def_en: to show or point to something
words.example: Ice cores indicate that the cooling began abruptly.
words.example_zh: 冰芯表明这次降温是突然开始的。

words.def_en: originating naturally in a particular place
words.example: The potato is indigenous to the Andes and was carried elsewhere later.
words.example_zh: 马铃薯原产于安第斯地区，后来才被带往别处。

words.def_en: certain to happen and impossible to avoid
words.example: Given the shrinking harbor, the decline of the port was inevitable.
words.example_zh: 鉴于港口不断淤浅，其衰落是不可避免的。

words.def_en: to reach a conclusion from evidence rather than direct statement
words.example: From the pollen record we infer that oaks replaced pines here.
words.example_zh: 从花粉记录可以推断，此地的松树被橡树取代。

words.def_en: existing as a natural and permanent part of something
words.example: The method has an inherent limit: it cannot date material older than fifty thousand years.
words.example_zh: 这种方法有其固有的局限：它无法测定五万年以上的材料。

words.def_en: to prevent or slow down a process
words.example: Cold water inhibits the growth of the bacteria responsible for decay.
words.example_zh: 低温水会抑制导致腐败的细菌生长。

words.def_en: occurring at the beginning; first
words.example: The initial survey missed the smaller mounds entirely.
words.example_zh: 最初的勘测完全遗漏了较小的土丘。

words.def_en: a new method, idea, or device
words.example: The heavy plow was the key innovation of medieval agriculture.
words.example_zh: 重犁是中世纪农业的关键创新。

words.def_en: to combine parts into a working whole
words.example: The atlas integrates satellite images with older ground surveys.
words.example_zh: 这本地图集把卫星影像与早期地面勘测整合在一起。

words.def_en: to explain the meaning of something
words.example: Scholars interpret the mural as a record of a royal marriage.
words.example_zh: 学者们把这幅壁画解读为一次王室联姻的记录。

words.def_en: to become involved in order to change a situation
words.example: Managers intervened by removing the predators from the island.
words.example_zh: 管理者通过清除岛上的捕食者进行了干预。

words.def_en: having many small parts arranged in a complicated way
words.example: The clock contains an intricate arrangement of gears and springs.
words.example_zh: 这座钟内部有一套精密复杂的齿轮和弹簧结构。

words.def_en: to include as a necessary part; to concern
words.example: The process involves heating the ore to more than a thousand degrees.
words.example_zh: 该工艺涉及把矿石加热到一千度以上。

words.def_en: to separate something from others
words.example: Rising seas isolated the population for the next ten thousand years.
words.example_zh: 海平面上升使这一族群在此后一万年间与世隔绝。

words.def_en: to show that something is reasonable or right
words.example: The scarcity of the metal justified its use only in ceremonial objects.
words.example_zh: 这种金属的稀缺使其只用于礼器成为合理之举。

words.def_en: producing a large profit
words.example: The spice trade was lucrative enough to finance whole fleets.
words.example_zh: 香料贸易利润丰厚，足以资助整支船队。

words.def_en: great size or importance; the measured size of something
words.example: No one grasped the magnitude of the loss until the survey was complete.
words.example_zh: 直到勘查结束，人们才明白损失之巨。

words.def_en: to keep something in the same condition or state
words.example: Coastal fog maintains the humidity that these ferns require.
words.example_zh: 沿海雾气维持着这些蕨类所需的湿度。

words.def_en: to handle or control skillfully, often unfairly
words.example: Researchers manipulated light levels to test the plant's response.
words.example_zh: 研究人员通过调控光照水平来检验该植物的反应。

words.def_en: a planned way of doing something
words.example: The dating method depends on the steady decay of a radioactive isotope.
words.example_zh: 这种测年方法依赖放射性同位素的稳定衰变。

words.def_en: showing extreme care about small details
words.example: The meticulous notes let later scholars repeat the experiment exactly.
words.example_zh: 这些一丝不苟的笔记使后来的学者能够精确重复实验。

words.def_en: to move from one region to another
words.example: The herds migrate north as the snow line retreats.
words.example_zh: 随着雪线后退，兽群向北迁徙。

words.def_en: as small in amount or degree as possible
words.example: The repairs caused minimal disturbance to the surrounding stonework.
words.example_zh: 修缮对周围石构件的扰动极小。

words.def_en: to make something bad less severe
words.example: Planting windbreaks mitigated the erosion along the field edges.
words.example_zh: 种植防风林减轻了田边的水土流失。

words.def_en: to change something slightly to improve it
words.example: Engineers modified the design after the first bridge failed.
words.example_zh: 第一座桥失事后，工程师修改了设计。

words.def_en: shared by two or more parties
words.example: The relationship is mutual, since each species feeds the other.
words.example_zh: 这种关系是互惠的，因为两个物种彼此供养。

words.def_en: so small that it can be ignored
words.example: The effect on global temperature was negligible compared with that of the oceans.
words.example_zh: 与海洋的作用相比，其对全球气温的影响微不足道。

words.def_en: a belief or general idea about something
words.example: The notion that deserts are lifeless is contradicted by the survey data.
words.example_zh: 认为沙漠没有生命的观念与调查数据相矛盾。

words.def_en: a very slight difference in meaning or quality
words.example: Translators often lose the nuance that distinguishes the two verbs.
words.example_zh: 译者常常丢失区分这两个动词的细微差别。

words.def_en: not well known; difficult to understand
words.example: The technique was described in an obscure journal and ignored for decades.
words.example_zh: 这项技术发表在一本不知名的期刊上，几十年间无人问津。

words.def_en: to get or acquire something
words.example: The dye was obtained from the shells of a single species of snail.
words.example_zh: 这种染料是从一种海螺的壳中提取的。

words.def_en: easy to see or understand
words.example: The advantage of the wheel was obvious on level ground but not in the mountains.
words.example_zh: 轮子的优势在平地上显而易见，但在山区并非如此。

words.def_en: to happen or take place
words.example: Such eruptions occur roughly once every four centuries.
words.example_zh: 这类喷发大约每四百年发生一次。

words.def_en: to balance out the effect of something
words.example: Gains in the highlands offset the losses along the coast.
words.example_zh: 高地的增长抵消了沿海的损失。

words.def_en: best or most favorable for a purpose
words.example: The optimal depth for planting the seed is about three centimeters.
words.example_zh: 播种的最佳深度约为三厘米。

words.def_en: a statement or situation that seems contradictory but may be true
words.example: The paradox is that the poorest soils supported the richest flora.
words.example_zh: 矛盾之处在于，最贫瘠的土壤却孕育了最丰富的植物群。

words.def_en: similar and occurring at the same time or in the same way
words.example: Writing developed in parallel ways in two unconnected regions.
words.example_zh: 文字在两个互不相干的地区以相似的方式发展起来。

words.def_en: to notice or become aware of something
words.example: Bees perceive ultraviolet patterns that are invisible to people.
words.example_zh: 蜜蜂能感知人眼看不见的紫外线图案。

words.def_en: to continue to exist or to keep doing something
words.example: The drought persisted for eleven consecutive growing seasons.
words.example_zh: 干旱持续了连续十一个生长季。

words.def_en: spread throughout every part of something
words.example: The influence of the workshop was pervasive in later provincial pottery.
words.example_zh: 该作坊的影响在后来的地方陶器中无处不在。

words.def_en: an observable fact or event
words.example: The phenomenon appears only when the air is unusually still.
words.example_zh: 这一现象只在空气异常静止时才出现。

words.def_en: seeming reasonable and likely to be true
words.example: A plausible explanation is that the river shifted course after the flood.
words.example_zh: 一个合理的解释是，洪水之后河道发生了改道。

words.def_en: to come or happen before something else
words.example: A long dry spell preceded the collapse of the terraces.
words.example_zh: 梯田崩塌之前有一段漫长的干旱期。

words.def_en: to make something impossible in advance
words.example: The thin atmosphere precludes the presence of liquid water at the surface.
words.example_zh: 稀薄的大气使地表不可能存在液态水。

words.def_en: most common or most powerful
words.example: Wheat was the predominant crop on the northern plain.
words.example_zh: 小麦是北部平原上的主要作物。

words.def_en: to be most common; to prove stronger in the end
words.example: Westerly winds prevail over the region for most of the year.
words.example_zh: 一年中大部分时间，该地区盛行西风。

words.def_en: coming before in time
words.example: The previous edition of the map omitted the eastern tributaries.
words.example_zh: 这幅地图的上一版漏掉了东部的支流。

words.def_en: first in importance or order
words.example: The primary source of the sediment is a glacier fifty kilometers away.
words.example_zh: 这些沉积物的主要来源是五十公里外的一条冰川。

words.def_en: very great or intense; showing deep insight
words.example: The invention had a profound effect on how information was stored.
words.example_zh: 这项发明对信息的存储方式产生了深远影响。

words.def_en: to increase rapidly in number
words.example: Algae proliferated once fertilizer runoff reached the lake.
words.example_zh: 化肥径流进入湖中后，藻类迅速繁殖。

words.def_en: easily noticed; important and well known
words.example: A prominent ridge divides the two watersheds.
words.example_zh: 一道显眼的山脊将两个流域分开。

words.def_en: to cause a strong reaction
words.example: The proposal provoked objections from every coastal province.
words.example_zh: 这项提案激起了各沿海省份的反对。

words.def_en: the full extent of variation between limits
words.example: The species tolerates a narrow range of temperatures.
words.example_zh: 该物种只能忍受很窄的温度范围。

words.def_en: to improve something by making small changes; to purify
words.example: Later chemists refined the technique until it could detect trace amounts.
words.example_zh: 后来的化学家不断改进这一技术，直到它能检测微量物质。

words.def_en: to make something stronger or more convincing
words.example: The second excavation reinforced the conclusion drawn from the first.
words.example_zh: 第二次发掘强化了从第一次发掘中得出的结论。

words.def_en: unwilling and hesitant to do something
words.example: Farmers were reluctant to adopt the new seed until yields were demonstrated.
words.example_zh: 在产量得到证明之前，农民不愿采用这种新种子。

words.def_en: to cause something to be in a certain state; to provide
words.example: The salt in the soil rendered the fields useless within a generation.
words.example_zh: 土壤中的盐分在一代人的时间内使这些田地变得无用。

words.def_en: to look or be similar to something
words.example: The larvae resemble small worms rather than adult insects.
words.example_zh: 幼虫看上去更像小蠕虫，而不像成年昆虫。

words.def_en: able to recover quickly after difficulty or damage
words.def_zh: 有韧性的；能迅速恢复的
words.example: Grasslands proved more resilient than forests after the fire.
words.example_zh: 火灾之后，草原比森林更能迅速恢复。

words.def_en: to keep within limits
words.example: Poor drainage restricts root growth to the upper soil layer.
words.example_zh: 排水不良使根系生长限制在表层土壤中。

words.def_en: to keep or continue to hold something
words.example: Clay soils retain water long after sandy soils have dried.
words.example_zh: 在沙土早已干燥之后，黏土仍能长时间保水。

words.def_en: to make something known or visible
words.example: The low tide revealed a pavement of fossil footprints.
words.example_zh: 退潮露出了一整片化石足迹铺成的地面。

words.def_en: stiff and not able to bend; strictly fixed
words.example: The rigid shell protects the animal but limits its growth.
words.example_zh: 坚硬的外壳保护着这种动物，却限制了它的生长。

words.def_en: basic and undeveloped; at an early stage
words.example: The earliest models had only a rudimentary system for correcting errors.
words.example_zh: 最早的机型只有一套简陋的纠错系统。

words.def_en: most noticeable or important
words.example: The salient feature of the design is the absence of interior columns.
words.example_zh: 该设计最突出的特点是内部没有立柱。

words.def_en: available in very small quantities
words.example: Timber was scarce, so the builders relied on mud brick.
words.example_zh: 木材稀缺，因此建造者依赖泥砖。

words.def_en: careful and detailed examination
words.example: The claim collapsed under the scrutiny of a second laboratory.
words.example_zh: 在第二家实验室的仔细审查下，这一说法站不住脚了。

words.def_en: an ordered series of events or things
words.example: The sequence of layers records four separate eruptions.
words.example_zh: 这些地层的先后顺序记录了四次独立的喷发。

words.def_en: happening naturally without external cause or planning
words.example: The reaction is spontaneous and requires no added heat.
words.example_zh: 该反应是自发的，不需要额外加热。

words.def_en: not likely to change or fail; firmly fixed
words.example: The climate remained stable for nearly three thousand years.
words.example_zh: 气候在近三千年间保持稳定。

words.def_en: not moving or developing
words.example: Trade remained stagnant until the road through the pass reopened.
words.example_zh: 在山口道路重新开通之前，贸易一直停滞不前。

words.def_en: to encourage activity or growth
words.example: Cheap credit stimulated construction in the port cities.
words.example_zh: 低息信贷刺激了港口城市的建设。

words.def_en: coming after something in time
words.example: Subsequent studies confirmed the pattern in three other valleys.
words.example_zh: 随后的研究在另外三个河谷证实了这一规律。

words.def_en: so slight as to be difficult to notice
words.example: The difference in glaze color is subtle but consistent.
words.example_zh: 釉色的差别虽细微，却始终如一。

words.def_en: as much as is needed
words.example: Rainfall alone is sufficient for the crop in most years.
words.example_zh: 在大多数年份，仅靠降雨就足以满足这种作物的需求。

words.def_en: to support or keep something going over time
words.example: The lagoon can sustain a fishery only if the inlet stays open.
words.example_zh: 只有入海口保持畅通，这片潟湖才能维持渔业。

words.def_en: the combining of separate parts into a whole
words.example: The book is a synthesis of field data and archival research.
words.example_zh: 这本书是野外数据与档案研究的综合。

words.def_en: real and able to be clearly seen or touched
words.example: The project produced tangible results within the first season.
words.example_zh: 这个项目在第一个季度就取得了实实在在的成果。

words.def_en: lasting for only a limited time
words.example: The camp was temporary and was rebuilt each spring.
words.example_zh: 这个营地是临时的，每年春天重建一次。

words.def_en: weak and not well supported
words.example: The link between the two cultures rests on tenuous evidence.
words.example_zh: 这两种文化之间的联系建立在薄弱的证据之上。

words.def_en: the point at which something begins to take effect
words.example: Below a certain threshold of light, the leaves stop producing sugar.
words.example_zh: 低于某一光照临界值时，叶片就停止合成糖分。

words.def_en: to change completely in form or nature
words.example: The railway transformed a market town into an industrial center.
words.example_zh: 铁路把一个集镇变成了工业中心。

words.def_en: to pass something on from one place or person to another
words.example: Mosquitoes transmit the parasite between hosts.
words.example_zh: 蚊子在宿主之间传播这种寄生虫。

words.def_en: found everywhere at the same time
words.example: Microplastics are now ubiquitous in ocean sediments.
words.example_zh: 微塑料如今在海洋沉积物中无处不在。

words.def_en: to weaken something gradually
words.example: The new dates undermine the traditional account of the migration.
words.example_zh: 这些新的年代数据削弱了关于这次迁徙的传统说法。

words.def_en: to differ or change from one case to another
words.example: Leaf size varies with altitude across the mountain range.
words.example_zh: 在整个山脉中，叶片大小随海拔而变化。

words.def_en: capable of working or surviving successfully
words.example: The colony was never viable without shipments from the mainland.
words.example_zh: 没有大陆的补给，这个殖民地从来无法维持。

words.def_en: likely to change suddenly; easily evaporating
words.example: Grain prices were volatile in years when the harvest was uncertain.
words.example_zh: 在收成不确定的年份，粮价波动剧烈。

words.def_en: easily harmed or attacked
words.example: Shallow reefs are especially vulnerable to warming water.
words.example_zh: 浅水珊瑚礁尤其容易受到水温升高的影响。

words.def_en: to produce or provide a result or amount
words.example: The trench yielded more than a thousand pottery fragments.
words.example_zh: 这条探沟出土了一千多块陶片。
